# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_REAL_FILLS_TOP_KEEPER_20260708

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adjusting SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK parameters to better align with real OPRA fills can capture edge by reducing slippage and false triggers. The edge exists because the baseline sniper strategy may be optimized for BS-sim fills, leading to discrepancies in real markets.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on a level break when: volume > vol_mult * average volume, candle body > body_min_cents, at least min_stars confluence factors, price within proximity_dollars of the level, and (if require_break_above_open is true) the break occurs above the open price. Exit uses a premium stop at premium_stop_pct, TP1 at tp1_premium_pct of premium with tp1_qty_fraction of quantity, runner target at runner_target_pct, and profit-lock armed at profit_lock_threshold_pct with stop offset at profit_lock_stop_offset_pct.
